lines.speaker: Ham
lines.text: Vin! Stay low. The line broke an hour ago — what you're seeing now isn't a battle, it's a hunt.

lines.speaker: Vin
lines.text: There are people still out there.

lines.speaker: Ham
lines.text: Wounded, mostly. The garrison's finishing whoever can't run. Get to as many as you can, send them this way, and don't — don't — try to stop the whole army yourself.

lines.speaker: Ham
lines.text: When their ranks reach the ridge, we go. With or without the stragglers.
